purpose: Verify coverage classifies requirements without stories and criteria without resolving test cases, and reports complete coverage with no gaps when everything is bound.
title: Coverage report

testCases.description: a requirement with no user story is classified uncovered
testCases.testPointer: test/query/coverage.test.js::REQ with zero US returns uncovered

testCases.description: an acceptance criterion with no test case cross-link is classified uncovered
testCases.testPointer: test/query/coverage.test.js::AC with no TC cross-link at all is absent (uncovered), not unresolved

testCases.description: a fully covered tree reports ok with zero uncovered
testCases.testPointer: test/query/coverage.test.js::shallow-any default: REQ with one AC covered by one RESOLVING TC returns covered
